Villa Rosengarten

Sauna & Fitness

The villa’s own wellness area in the old barn – relaxation after a day at the sea.

  • Finnish sauna
  • Fitness area with dumbbells & punching bag
  • Relaxation & lounge area
  • Low season & winter, for a surcharge

In the villa’s old barn, our guests have their own small wellness and fitness area. Downstairs, loungers beneath exposed wooden beams invite you to relax – the ideal spot to wind down after a long beach day or a session of kiting.

The Finnish sauna provides cosy warmth and relaxation for body and mind. Upstairs, a small fitness area with a punching bag, weight bench and training mats is ready for anyone who doesn’t want to skip their workout, even on holiday.

The sauna and fitness area are available to all Villa Rosengarten guests in the low season and winter, by individual appointment and for a surcharge. Feel free to ask us during your stay, or write to us in advance via the contact form.
